scripts.build: npm run build -w @image-service/client && npm run build -w @image-service/api && npm run build -w @image-service/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @image-service/client && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @image-service/api" "npm run dev -w @image-service/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @image-service/client && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
